services.name: Fall fishing
services.desc: November is the month in which we take a moment to show our gratitude to everyone and everything we have that enriches our lives. At Wave Dancer Charters, we are so thankful for our family and friends, our amazing team, and-of course-the fishermen and women that we are excited to take out on the water […] Looking for the perfect place for a fall vacation? Maybe some place warm, fun, and with the most fantastic fishing in the United States? Then you’ll want to consider Galveston, Texas. quotes.text: We had the best time with Capt Travis and his deck hand Travis! They were so much fun and we had a blast!!! We caught a lot of fish! They worked hard to get us on the fish and made sure my son had the time of his life! This trip was his graduation present. I would recommend Wave Dancer charters to ANYONE! We will def be back for more fishing fun! A class act fishing boat. You won't be disappointed! Already planning another trip for my birthday!!! Sara Thacker - Client

Captain Taylor now that I am back home all I can think about is the time I spent with you and Gunnar and my Family last week . I am forever Greatful to have had the pleasure of meeting both of you men your knowledge of the sea the kindness you showed us made our charter absolutely the best time spent out on the ocean I can not imagine doing another charter out of Galveston with out you guys good luck and until next time God Bless! Gary Gorman - Client

Captain Taylor and his deck hand treated us like family. I have three children and they made it an awesome experience for them. Taylor and his deck mate are so respectful and hard working. I highly recommend this charter service. Thanks guys. Gabe Spears - Client
